description: This PHP source file interfaces with Jira for issue creation and version handling, specifically in the context of the TestLink project. It demonstrates configuration setup, connection testing, and issue creation via a SOAP interface in the Jira issue tracker.

classes.name: jirasoapInterface
classes.description: A class representing the SOAP interface to Jira for issue tracking operations.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the SOAP interface is successfully connected to Jira.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Jira with the provided summary and description.
